regions.contentLimits: One small elevated administration link outside the phone frame.
regions.overflow: The translucent elevated link remains outside the frame at every viewport width.

regions.contentLimits: One dark-graphite phone frame with selected image or video media, gallery and share controls, three local gallery pages, and progressive upload spaces. A brief decorative supplied-logo splash appears inside the phone screen.
regions.overflow: Visible tiles fill the full gallery surface behind compact translucent close, title, count, and page-navigation controls. The matching glass header and page-navigation surfaces use the same subtle edge and stronger translucent surface. The empty personal page uses a muted background beneath its floating controls. The header omits the page description, and page actions show their destination title with a directional icon. When another upload tile is revealed, the grid adds a row and every tile reduces in size to remain visible. More than 12 visible tiles scroll within the gallery surface.

responsive.compact: The phone frame fills the available viewport with the Admin link outside its upper edge.
responsive.wide: The phone frame stays centered at the phone container width while the Admin link remains outside it.

focus.onOpen: Opening the gallery follows normal document focus order inside the phone frame.
focus.onClose: Closing the gallery returns focus to the gallery icon.
focus.onError: Local gallery and file failures are announced without moving focus.

accessibility.headings: The immersive route has no root page heading. An open gallery exposes its current page title as a level-two heading, and every control has a programmatic label.
accessibility.labels: Media controls name the image, video, or upload operation. Uploaded media uses its file name as alternative text.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: Gallery, file, playback, and sharing failures use an alert. Page position announces as the person moves between gallery pages.
